episodes.synopsis: Saki is the last of her friends of finally to be touched by a Blessing Spirit, but at the Unified Class her skills are lacking. And talk of missing children taken by the trickster cat continues to scare her.
episodes.title: The Season of New Leaves

episodes.synopsis: Another student is removed from the roster. Saki uses her power outside of class.
episodes.title: Vanishing Children

episodes.synopsis: The group has rowed past their designated safe areas in search of monsters. What they find is worse than what they originally imagined.
episodes.title: The False Minoshiro

episodes.synopsis: As the library continues to explain the history of the world, a danger looms in the background.
episodes.title: Bloody History

episodes.synopsis: Satoru and Saki have been split up from the rest of the group and captured by the outside Monster Rat group.
episodes.title: Pursuit on a Hot Night

episodes.synopsis: Saki has figured out a way to help her and Satoru to escape, but in their escape they are thrown deeper in the war between the clans.
episodes.title: Escape

episodes.synopsis: Satoru is getting tired and his power is waning and the Earth Spider Colony army is much larger than expected. When all seems lost, help comes from an ally that could be much more dangerous.
episodes.title: Summer Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Two years have passed since the camping incident and the relationship between the friends has changed dramatically.
episodes.title: Omen

episodes.synopsis: Saki and friends are looking for Shun but hit road blocks everywhere they turn. After dinner, Saki remembers a name from the past and Maria flies in with some big news.
episodes.title: The Rising Wind

episodes.synopsis: Saki has found Shun; he has changed dramatically and asks Saki to leave. Her refusal breaks him down and he explains everything.
episodes.title: More than the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Saki fears the Ethics Committee is somehow altering the memories of her and her classmates. But when Mamoru has a breakdown, Saki is asked to quit looking for answers.
episodes.title: Distant Thunder in Winter

episodes.synopsis: Saki sits down with head of the ethics committee, Asahina Tomiko. Asahina begins to tell her the other side of the town’s history.
episodes.title: Weak Link

episodes.synopsis: When Mamoru runs away, his friends do what any good friends do - they try to find him. But on their search, they soon discover that they aren't the only ones tracking him.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Saki and Satoru have returned to the village, but upon arrival Saki is ushered to a meeting with the Education Committee. Her fate is now in the hands of the adults who know all her secrets.
episodes.title: Snowflakes

episodes.synopsis: While searching for Maria and Mamoru, Saki and Satoru meet their old friend Squealer. He invites them to the new Robber Fly colony where things have changed greatly, but where is the Queen?
episodes.title: Afterimage

episodes.synopsis: Maria is gone; she has left Saki a letter explaining her decision. Saki is up against terrible odds - the disappearance of her friends, the fact that her memory may be erased again, and the monster rats might not be on the side of the gods after all!
episodes.title: To My Beloved Saki

episodes.synopsis: Many years have passed; Saki and Satoru have grown and moved their separate ways. But recent actions within the monster rat community have brought them back together.
episodes.title: Footsteps of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: Many events act as catalysts in an impending war.
episodes.title: Scarlet Flower

episodes.synopsis: Searching for survivors in the hospital, Saki and the group she and Satoru have joined up with discover Yakomaru’s secret.
episodes.title: Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Someone or something is following Saki and Satoru as they glide down the river discussing what has happened.
episodes.title: A Cold and Sunlit Place

episodes.synopsis: As Niimi stays behind to fulfill Tomiko’s last order, Saki and Sataru head toward the Temple of Purification. When they get there they learn the true extent of Yakomaru’s true plan.
episodes.title: The Fire that Destroys the World

episodes.synopsis: Saki receives a gift from her mother, followed by one final request.
episodes.title: Tokyo

episodes.synopsis: Kiroumaru has suggested that they split up to distract their pursuers, but are his intentions noble?
episodes.title: The Face of the Boy

episodes.synopsis: Things become increasingly more complicated after Inui faces the ultimate fate, Kiroumaru is suspected of being a traitor, and Saki has second thoughts about killing the ogre.
episodes.title: Torchlight in the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: After all the scores are settled, ten years go by. Saki and Satoru hope for a better world.
episodes.title: From the New World
